display.purpose: Landing heroes and major section titles — Cormorant Garamond only.

mono.purpose: Authed app shell and cost/metadata display — Geist Mono.

shadows.name: xs
shadows.purpose: Cards, inputs, outline buttons at rest.

motion.name: stagger-child
motion.purpose: Stagger between list/panel children in app dashboard.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action — signup, add subscription, save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.9938 0.0013 106.4231); background: oklch(0.6908 0.1909 45.0151); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.6908 0.1909 45.0151 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.745 0.1322 54.6845 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions — cancel, back, low-emphasis CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.2431 0.0076 95.3724); background: oklch(0.9938 0.0013 106.4231); border: 1px solid oklch(0.8852 0.0042 91.4508); border-radius: 0.25rem; box-shadow: 0px 4px 8px -1px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.9556 0.0017 67.802); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.745 0.1322 54.6845 / 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field for subscription name, price, etc.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.2431 0.0076 95.3724); background: transparent; border: 1px solid oklch(0.8852 0.0042 91.4508); border-radius: 0.25rem; box-shadow: 0px 4px 8px -1px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.05); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.4981 0.0078 106.6789); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.745 0.1322 54.6845); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.745 0.1322 54.6845 / 0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Subscription summary or feature block container.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: oklch(0.9923 0.0025 48.7201); color: oklch(0.2431 0.0076 95.3724); border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0px 4px 8px -1px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.05); outline: 1px solid oklch(0.2431 0.0076 95.3724 / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.4981 0.0078 106.6789); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Marketing Nav
components.description: Landing page header — logo + serif wordmark.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem 0; } .ds-nav-mark { font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.2431 0.0076 95.3724); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

narrative.overview: Subman looks like a fintech app that grew up reading magazines — Monzo's approachable money clarity, with Cormorant Garamond giving headlines editorial weight. The UI is product-first: dense enough to be useful, light enough to feel human. Wit lives in copy and micro-moments, not in decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Warm tangerine accent on cool near-white surfaces — restrained, not drenched
Serif display + sans body + mono for app chrome
Tight 4px base radius — confident, not pill-shaped
Subtle ring + xs shadow for depth; flat at rest on most surfaces
Motion via spring/ease-out reveals; always respects reduced motion

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Primary orange appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity signals action, not decoration.

rules.name: The No-Cream Rule
rules.body: Background neutrals stay at chroma ≤0.006. Warmth comes from accent and typography, not a sand-tinted body.

rules.name: The Pairing Rule
rules.body: Never stack two similar sans-serifs. Cormorant + Manrope is the only display/body pair.

rules.name: The Display Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Hero clamp max is 6rem (~96px). Larger reads as shouting, not designing.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows respond to state (hover, focus, modal), not decorate idle cards.

rules.name: The No Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Never pair border: 1px solid with soft shadows ≥16px blur on the same element.

dos: Do use Warm Tangerine only for primary actions, links, and focus — ≤10% of surface area.
Do lead marketing headlines with Cormorant Garamond; keep forms and tables in Manrope.
Do use muted sections (Whisper bg) for hero containment instead of gradient fills.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: crossfade or instant state changes for all motion/react animations.
Do write candid, lightly witty copy in empty states and confirmations — Monzo energy, not stand-up comedy.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS patterns: purple gradients, hero metrics, identical icon+heading+blurb feature grids.
Don't guilt-trip in copy or UI — no alarmist red spend totals without context; clarity over shame.
Don't adopt corporate fintech visuals: navy/gold, stock photos, trust-badge walls.
Don't use AI-default UI: cream/sand body backgrounds, eyebrow kickers on every section, side-stripe card accents, gradient text.
Don't exceed 16px card radius or pair 1px borders with wide soft shadows on the same element.
Don't nest cards inside cards — use spacing and typography for hierarchy instead.
